measurements.scope: The hydrographic survey distinguishes the Agulhas Return Current from the Agulhas Current and traces its weakening eastward flow toward the Crozet Basin. This derived distance floor is not a measured streamline, whole-current length, or the length of the westward Agulhas Current.
measurements.source_locator: PDF pages 20–22, Figure 14 and Section 6 Conclusions, Agulhas Return Current surveyed eastward from 18°E to 76°E; 3,000 km floor is OSW gate geometry

adcp_threshold_context.source_error_definition: Total error includes independent northern/southern-edge positioning errors from 9.6 km ADCP point spacing and projection-angle variation. Table 1 separately reports projection uncertainty; it is a component, not an independent allowance to add again.

widths.boundary_rule: Distance between half-maximum velocity isotachs in each ADCP depth bin, projected normal to that bin’s maximum velocity vector; source reports the median of these distances.
widths.extraction_method: Width, total error and projection component transcribed from original Table 1 after rendered visual inspection; source methods retained without edge digitization.
widths.geographic_scope: Near 39 S, 22 E; source body differs from preliminary poster 23 E. Local Seward Johnson cruise crossing, not the full current envelope.
widths.layer: Near-surface and upper-ocean ADCP bins; deepest reported bin 325–375 m, nominal center 350 m. Width is a median across bins, not a fixed-depth surface width or 0–1000 m width.
widths.name: Agulhas Return Current
widths.range_interpretation: Source ± total error estimate is stored separately; no confidence level or seasonal range supplied. Projection error is already a component of total error.
remaining_gates: Recover exact crossing dates and bin membership before temporal or fixed-layer admission.

widths.section_orientation: Flow-normal projection for each depth bin; source reports a median across bin widths.
